setting: Domestic and church-life scenes drawn in flat whiteboard terms: a quiet single-home interior (kitchen table with Bible and coffee, bedroom and closet with a saved dress, spare room), a seaside wedding venue and church reception/brunch corner table, all on a plain muted-color background with simple 2D outline props (chairs, table, hymnbook, invitation, shoebox). Scenes move between intimate home moments and congregation/worship spaces with a hand-drawn, low-detail churchy vibe.
spiritual_theme: The transformation from fear-disguised ‘waiting’ to repentant, obedient living: realizing waiting is not always God’s will but sometimes self-imposed fear; repentance, reclaiming life, trusting God’s patient love and opening the door to fullness of life and relational healing.
emotional_palette: muted warm sepia base with dusty blue shadows, soft desaturated yellow accents (warmth of the painted room), and gentle rose highlights for tender moments—overall quiet, hopeful tones.
